tier_reason: Raised B to A: the record's benchmark_url, google/wuffs doc/benchmarks.md, is a reproducible third-party run that pins libspng 0.7.3 (post-9c35dc3), Wuffs 315b2e52, an Intel Core i5-10210U, clang 11.0.1 and gcc 10.2.1 at -O3 with the public mimic harness (test/c/std/png.c -DWUFFS_MIMIC), giving libspng 1.02-1.05x libpng on the small images, 1.36x on 552k_32bpp with checksum verification and 1.60x with checksums ignored; the record had cited the older blog run on an m3-6Y30. Public code, compiler, flags and CPU are all stated, so A. Caveats: libspng still skips the final IDAT CRC-32 (decode_image stops at SPNG_STATE_EOI) while paying a scalar RGBA-to-BGRA swap; the mango README rows are first-party, single cold runs where SPNG_CRC_USE also disables Adler-32 and libpng runs its defaults in native layout, with milliseconds printed as us%10 (a decimal error). Maintenance correction: the last code release is v0.7.4 (2023-05-08) with 69 issues and 18 PRs open, so not active.

corrections.claimed_speedup: google/wuffs doc/benchmarks.md (third-party, reproducible; libspng 0.7.3, i5-10210U, clang 11.0.1 and gcc 10.2.1 -O3, libpng = 1.00x): 1.02x to 1.05x on the 19k, 40k, 77k and 4002k images, 1.36x on 552k_32bpp with checksum verification, 1.60x with checksums ignored (libpng cannot skip checksums). Older blog run (m3-6Y30): 1.02-1.07x and 1.33-1.39x verify, 1.62x ignore. mango README (i7-11800H, first-party single cold run, SPNG_CRC_USE also disables Adler-32): 2560x1600 decode 37.7 vs 57.3 ms (1.52x), encode 215.9 vs 820.5 ms (3.8x); 4833x5875 decode 296.6 vs 379.5 ms (1.28x), encode 2424.7 vs 14051.3 ms.
corrections.hardware: Intel Core i5-10210U (google/wuffs doc/benchmarks.md run); Intel Core m3-6Y30 at 0.90 GHz for the older Wuffs blog run; Intel Core i7-11800H for the mango README numbers
corrections.compiler_and_flags: clang 11.0.1 and gcc 10.2.1 at -O3 with -DWUFFS_MIMIC (doc/benchmarks.md; gcc -O3 test/c/std/png.c -DWUFFS_MIMIC -lm -lpng -lz); libspng spng.c is #included into the harness translation unit; libpng 1.6.37 is the Debian Bullseye package
corrections.maintenance_status: stale: last code release v0.7.4 on 2023-05-08; 69 issues and 18 pull requests open
corrections.caveats: libspng skips the final IDAT CRC-32 (decode_image stops at SPNG_STATE_EOI) while paying a scalar RGBA-to-BGRA swap in the harness. The mango rows are first-party single cold runs where SPNG_CRC_USE also disables Adler-32, libpng runs its defaults in native layout, and milliseconds are printed as us%10 (decimal error). Encode is slower than libpng in the project's own issues: #224 (confirmed bug) spng 740 ms vs libpng 510 ms at level 6 with zlib-ng; #274 64-bit encode 3x slower. #285 eXIf wild read fixed in 0.7.4 without a CVE.
